# Replace Koala tracking with signals tracking script ## Summary This PR replaces the existing Koala tracking system with a new signals tracking script from CR-Relay. The changes include: - **Script replacement**: Updated the tracking pixel script from Koala's CDN to the signals script from `cdn.cr-relay.com` - **API calls updated**: Changed all `ko.identify()` calls to `signals.identify()` in newsletter signup and pricing demo forms - **File organization**: Renamed `pixels_koala.py` to `pixels_signals.py` and updated imports accordingly - **Error handling preserved**: Maintained existing try/catch blocks around JavaScript tracking calls The signals script provides the same API surface (`identify`, `track`, `page`, `form` methods) as the Koala script, making this a relatively straightforward replacement. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human ⚠️ **Important**: Local testing was blocked by reflex server authentication issues, so these changes have not been verified in a running environment. - [ ] **Verify signals script loads correctly** - Navigate to any page and check browser dev tools Network tab to confirm the signals script loads from `https://cdn.cr-relay.com/v1/site/b608b3c3-5dea-4365-b685-6b6635c7fda5/signals.js` - [ ] **Test newsletter signup tracking** - Submit the newsletter signup form and verify `signals.identify()` is called successfully (check browser console and network requests) - [ ] **Test pricing demo tracking** - Submit the pricing demo form and verify `signals.identify()` is called without JavaScript errors - [ ] **Check browser console for errors** - Ensure no JavaScript errors are thrown related to the signals tracking script - [ ] **Verify tracking data reception** - Check the signals/CR-Relay dashboard to confirm tracking events are being received correctly --- ### Diagram ```mermaid %%{ init : { "theme" : "default" }}%% graph TB App["Main Reflex App

QuoteFormState.submit()"]:::minor-edit App --> PixelsMain PixelsMain --> PixelsSignals Signup --> |"rx.call_script(signals.identify)"| PixelsSignals Pricing --> |"rx.call_script(signals.identify)"| PixelsSignals subgraph Legend L1[Major Edit]:::major-edit L2[Minor Edit]:::minor-edit L3[Context/No Edit]:::context end classDef major-edit fill:#90EE90 classDef minor-edit fill:#87CEEB classDef context fill:#FFFFFF ``` ### Notes - **Session**: Requested by Alek (@Alek99) - [Devin session link](https://app.devin.ai/sessions/1a4e0d2ccdd44a1183286aea2e568151) - **Environment issue**: The reflex development server got stuck on "Validating access token" and couldn't complete startup, preventing local testing - **Script source**: The new signals script and site ID were provided by the user in the task description - **Backward compatibility**: The signals API maintains the same method names as Koala (`identify`, `track`, etc.) so the transition should be seamless if the script loads correctly
